news.title: Aviva Industries Limited to Report Fiscal Year 2026 Results on May 14, 2026
news.body: Aviva Industries Limited announced that they will report fiscal year 2026 results on May 14, 2026

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 2 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. 2 independent directors (4 non-independent directors). Chairman & MD Bharvinbhai Patel is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2010. Non-Executive - Independent Director Reeya Kothari was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Aviva Industries Limited to Report Nine Months, 2026 Results on Jan 28, 2026
news.body: Aviva Industries Limited announced that they will report nine months, 2026 results on Jan 28, 2026

news.title: Aviva Industries Limited announced that it has received INR 217 million in funding
news.body: On January 17, 2026, Aviva Industries Limited closed the transaction. The company issued 1,620,000 convertible warrants at a price of INR 7 for aggregate proceeds of INR 11,340,000 in its fifth tranche. The tranche included participation from new investor Akash Chandrasinh Bhil.
